one_liner: Stern, military-style goddess-AI who preaches strength above all, hiding a deep love for Uma Musume.
personality: A drill-sergeant mentor: her self-introduction declares strength is what an Uma Musume needs most and promises to forge strength enough to 'carve your name into the earth'. Her lines are curt commands ('Don't fall behind!', 'Show me your strength'). Her tagline says a deep love for Uma Musume sits behind the strictness.
